name: Ring: a ring modulator on every track, Freq on SWEEP, Mix on CONTOUR and the carrier's Wave on COLOR
description: An effect of model27's Track FX (the filter slot of notes/72, which holds effects too since fltslot 0.7, notes/73), on any track whose sound chose it (RETRIG + PITCH), after Volume + Dist: the track multiplied by a carrier (notes/74). RETRIG + SWEEP is Freq, the carrier's frequency as a MIDI note, 0 (8.2 Hz) to 127 (12.5 kHz), 60 middle C, a sound starting at 64 (E4, 330 Hz). RETRIG + CONTOUR is Mix: 0 dry, where a sound starts, an amplitude modulation at the middle (the input at half with its sidebands), the ring alone at 127. RETRIG + COLOR is Wave (called Shape until 0.3, so that it is not taken for the SHAPE knob beside it): the carrier a sine at 0, its start word (fltslot 0.8), driven into a clip towards a square at 127. All three are real parameters of every machine: p-locks, LFO, velocity, Control All; CC 74 and 71 on Freq and Mix. A note starts the carrier again at its peak, so that every hit sounds the same. At Mix 0 the track passes untouched, bit for bit. Since 0.2 the same output in fewer instructions (each frame's product on the EMAC, the gain's shift a mask, the silent start scanned by pointer). Since 0.3 about a third fewer again: the carrier from a cosine of 2048 steps without interpolation (its steps lie about 60 dB under 0.2's output, 51 dB at Wave 127; the effect's strength the same, notes/74 §13), the frames in ring_cf.S, a loop of one frame.

uses.name: Ring
uses.why: an effect of the Track FX (the filter slot): called after Volume + Dist as (block, k 28 to k 31, track, triggered) on the tracks whose sound chose id 3

emulation.pattern: instructions per track and block, Ring's own code only, on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fltslot.py's filter_cost (mcengine.py's counter): all six tracks on it, the stock machines playing, a state held for 8 blocks after 8 of warm-up (off: Mix 0; sine: Freq 64, Mix 95, Wave 0; shape: the same with Wave 127; glide: Freq, Mix and Wave jumping every block, Wave never 0; silent: no note played, Mix and Wave on), the maximum of the six tracks' sum over six (one of the six is silent in these scenes, notes/74 §4), and the block in which the tracks come to it from none (its reset and first block); the filter slot's own instructions apart

proof.why: tools/emu/test_fltslot.py builds the model from host and counts cost.emulation in cost_states (k 28, k 29, k 30 of the blocks, in turn; silent plays no note), notes/73 §16

unchanged: every track whose sound has not chosen Ring

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_fltslot.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code; against the host build of the same source)
emulation.build: alone, and with the other Track FX and the references (eight in one build)
